Here is a short patient-facing note for the teaching refill lab:

We are processing your refill request for lisinopril. Our system checked your chart and found that you have an active script with refills available. As per our policy, since your script is not expired and you have refills remaining, we are approving your refill request without a pharmacist review.

Please note that our system generated this approval, and it does not replace a pharmacist's professional judgment. If you have any questions or concerns about your medication, please reach out to your prescriber.

Thank you for choosing [Teaching Pharmacy] for your prescription needs.

[Teaching Pharmacy]"
